verdict.rationale: AngelList ships one built-in AI feature, the Tie Out Assistant. It uses AI to find mismatches between legal documents and the cap table and surfaces them in a Health Checks dashboard, so users can hand off this single reconciliation task. Nothing shows a general-purpose assistant that accepts arbitrary delegated tasks. Missing for 10: a general conversational or agentic assistant that takes delegated tasks across the product, AI that executes actions (grants, transfers, consents) rather than only flagging issues, detailed docs on the assistant's scope, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
